user.title: CAISO Stats
user.description: Adds California ISO grid conditions (status, demand, reserves, supply mix, CO2) and load-shifting signals. Uses CAISO's free public Today's Outlook feeds; no account or key needed. Polls every 15 minutes by default.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach CAISO's stats feed. Check the internet connection and try again.

abort.single_instance_allowed: CAISO Stats is already configured. Change its settings under Configure.

init.title: CAISO Stats options
init.description: Polling interval and the thresholds behind the load-shifting signals.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll CAISO (5-60 minutes). Live stats are fetched every poll; the net demand forecast about once an hour.
data_description.clean_co2_threshold: Clean energy now is on when grid CO2 intensity is at or below this.
data_description.peak_percent: Peak demand period is on when net demand reaches this share of today's forecast net demand peak.
data_description.reserve_ratio_threshold: Grid stress is on when operating reserve falls below this share of the required reserve (or CAISO reports any non-normal grid status).
data_description.surplus_battery_mw: Solar surplus is on when grid batteries are charging at least this hard...
data_description.surplus_share: ...or when solar + wind supply at least this share of demand.
data_description.window_hours: Length of the lowest net demand window searched for in the rest of today's forecast.
data_description.index_days: Days of history (7-30) whose cleanest and dirtiest hour set the CO2 intensity index's 0 and 100.
